summary: Onboard a supplier with a bank account that a second person verifies
acceptanceCriteria: Account 9-18 digits; IFSC ^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$; invalid input returns 422.
Supplier is pending until a FINANCE_APPROVER verifies the account.
The person who added the account cannot verify it (SELF_VERIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED)..
